verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a realtime communications platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no assistant users can delegate tasks to. The AI-generated meeting summary is a single fixed feature, not a delegable assistant. The Workers AI transcription and speech pattern is a developer building block for constructing one, not a built-in capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
